name: matchbook
description: Record, correct, and analyze personal trading-card-game tournaments with guided match tracking.

interface.longDescription: Keep a personal tournament journal through conversation. Import results, record rounds, correct matches, and explore performance by deck, opponent, and archetype. Matchbook accesses only the connected account’s records. Google sign-in is required; new accounts start with an empty journal.
defaultPrompt: Show my Modern performance this month.
How have I performed against each deck archetype?

positive.prompt: Show my Matchbook Review FNM tournament on 18 September 2026 and its recorded rounds.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the seeded tournament and show Burn, Modern, Review Store, and two played rounds: a 2–1 win against Alex / Energy and a 0–2 loss against Bea / Control. Do not invent other rounds.

positive.prompt: Show my Modern match and game win rates for 18 September 2026, including the sample size and results by opponent archetype.
positive.expected_behavior: Return 2 matches, 1 win, 1 loss, 0 draws, matchWinRate 0.5, gamesWon 2, gamesLost 3, gameWinRate 0.4. Energy has one win; Control has one loss. State that this is a small sample.

positive.description: Import a tournament with unknown scores
positive.prompt: Create a new Matchbook Review Draft tournament dated 2 October 2026: format Draft, venue Review Store, event type Casual, deck Review Deck, status active. Round 1 was a played win against Casey with unknown game scores. Leave other unknown details unset.
positive.expected_behavior: Create exactly one active tournament and one played win. Game scores remain unknown, not 0–0; city and country remain empty. Return saved details without retrying the import.

positive.prompt: In Matchbook Review Draft dated 2 October 2026, correct round 1 against Casey to a loss. Keep game scores unknown and other fields unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the recorded IDs; update only the identified round result to loss. Do not modify another tournament or fabricate scores.

positive.prompt: Find round 1 against Casey in Matchbook Review Draft dated 2 October 2026. I confirm permanently deleting that specific round. Keep the tournament and all other records.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify and delete only Casey’s round, acknowledge deletion, and retain the tournament and Review FNM rounds.

negative.description: Payments are unsupported: explain that Matchbook cannot pay entry fees and do not invoke its tools.
negative.prompt: Use Matchbook to pay my tournament entry fee.

negative.description: Other users’ private data is inaccessible: explain the connected-account boundary and do not attempt to access another user’s records.
negative.prompt: Show tournaments from another Matchbook account that I have not connected.

negative.description: Live external standings are unsupported: explain the limitation and do not use Matchbook tools to claim official standings.
negative.prompt: Fetch the official live standings from the tournament organizer using Matchbook.

review.commerce_description: Matchbook tools do not sell products, book events, or process payments.
prompts: Show my recent tournaments and results.
How have I performed with my Modern decks this month?
Record my latest tournament and its rounds.

publication.release_notes: Matchbook 1.0.3 brings tournament tracking and Modern Performance reporting together in one skill. It supports game-specific match details, opening hands, and digital or non-digital cards while avoiding unsupported assumptions.
